risks.title: Cybersecurity
risks.score_rationale: The Board of Directors considers cybersecurity risks critical to the company. Cybersecurity governance is overseen by the Security and Technology Risk Committee and the Enterprise Risk Management Committee, with escalation to the Board's Risk and Compliance Committee.

risks.title: Data Regulation and Compliance
risks.score_rationale: TransUnion operates under a strict regulatory framework regarding data protection and privacy, with close oversight by the Risk and Compliance Committee.

risks.title: Market Competition
risks.score_rationale: TransUnion operates in a competitive data and analytics market with competitors offering similar or differentiated solutions.

risks.title: Litigation and Legal Actions
risks.score_rationale: TransUnion is exposed to litigation risks, particularly related to data protection, privacy, and business practices.

risks.title: Reputation and Trust
risks.score_rationale: TransUnion's reputation is fundamental to its 'Information for Good' positioning. Any incident involving data handling or security could severely impact customer and consumer trust.

ai_positioning.summary: TransUnion positions AI as a core element of its strategy. The OneTru platform uses AI-powered analytics for persistent identity resolution and contextualized insight generation. AI is explicitly mentioned as a key factor supporting growth in the data and analytics market.
evidence: OneTru solution enablement platform uses AI-powered analytics
AI enables data processing more quickly and efficiently to provide business insights
Listed among key underlying trends supporting market growth
